name: Tafjord ski trek — native Kartverket terrain candidates

method.objective: Horizontal distance weighted by 1 + P*(10*grade + 6**(5*grade-1) - 1/6), grade=tan(terrain slope), P=1 for every published minimum. No low-slope cutoff.
method.candidate_policy: Unpinned whole-route shortest-cost descent in a recentered sparse corridor: 600 m coarse / 20 m fine, certified finally at 1200 m coarse / 60 m fine. No length constraint or distance pressure during descent. Named regions are seeds only. Accept <=2 times the shortest converged minimum length and <=1.35 times the best eligible minimum cost. Alternatives require symmetric separation over >=15% of each route and a continuous run >=max(750 m,12% of reference length), at separation max(150 m,min(500 m,2.5% of reference length)).
method.source: Kartverket NHM DTM, nhm_dtm_topo_25832, EPSG:25832, native 1 m grid
method.heading_rule: On the 10 m gradient field above 10 degrees, deviation from uphill/downhill fall line <= 90 - 3*slope degrees.
method.grid: Sparse 4 m corridor plus 1 m band around the complete route, including endpoints. Every edge checked against native 1 m slope and 10 m heading fields.
method.validation: Independent exact segment/cell integration, recomputing gradients from cached float elevations. Reported slope figures describe this terrain model.

limits.reference: Shortest converged local minimum found for the same endpoints, before geographic/cost filtering

method.day1_under20: The earlier sub-20° search to Torsbu found no verified candidate; no such option is claimed by this minimum search.
method.scope: Terrain-only ground model; snow cover, ice and avalanche exposure are not modeled. Discrete finite-coverage candidates, not proven global optima.

terrain_validation.warning: Kartverket 1 m terrain checks; fall-line direction measured across 10 m. Planning candidates, not field-verified tracks. Day 1 exceeds the requested 20-degree preference; inspect its reported native terrain maximum.

local_optimum.method: whole-route moving sparse corridor; no pinned intermediate vertices or length pressure
